relevant_findings: The guide recommends documenting the storage bank used during sampling.
It recommends sampling at the nominal HRS delivery temperature and at pressure above 20 MPa, preferably the nominal 35 or 70 MPa filling pressure.
For parallel sampling it recommends documenting the fueling protocol and excluding abnormal or aborted fills.
missing_for_current_model_validation: synchronized station-to-vehicle pressure, temperature and mass-flow time series
channel dictionary and engineering units for the existing public workbooks
vehicle tank internal diameter and length
decision: The source is useful procedural evidence but cannot supply the missing MetHyTrucks workbook mapping or validate the station/tank thermal model. No validation score or readiness gate changes.
implementation_response: Connect explicit receptacle pressure, temperature and physical nozzle diameter to the opt-in mixed-convection tank model while retaining constant-UA as the default.
claim_boundary: This record documents a public-source recheck and an implementation decision. It is not experimental validation, full-loop validation, SAE J2601 conformance, or evidence of safety performance.
